inspections.finding: The complete zayin ends in a broad joined horizontal mass with a shallow central lug. The genuine same-page bare zayin of אז has a narrow plain terminal, so simple absence cannot be certified here. The nearby זעמך20 comparison also has a coalesced lower plateau and supplies no independent missing class. Literal patah is a shallow bar and qamats has a substantial stem, but the target lacks a uniquely separable complete bar/stem or pair anatomy; retain the note rather than supply a vowel from the similar word.

The complete ayin has a broad coalesced lower-left mass ending in a rightward rounded lobe. The nearby complete זעמך20 and its ayin remain merged too; neither word identity nor their printed canonical transcription is a control for the missing target point. Compared with the literal shallow patah, deep qamats and vertical-dot class controls, the target does not separate an ordinary foot from any unique simple or compound point arrangement. Retain without an absence claim.

The complete ordinary oblique lamed terminal continues into two added comparably rounded vertical nodes separated by side waists. Literal same-font lamed sheva repeats the pair; the genuine bare final lamed stops at its diagonal foot and hiriq has one extra node. Literal qamats has an unequal broad horizontal shoulder, narrow descending stem and terminal button; patah has one shallow bar. The complete target lacks those competing arrangements. Certify U+05B0 from the original contour only.

The bet footer is greatly thickened into a rounded lower mass with a tiny basal notch. The exact same-page bet tsere of ביניהם preserves two distinct low tips and an intervening valley/window; the target does not preserve the complete corresponding separation. Patah/qamats and fused multi-dot interpretations are not uniquely excluded by its shallow notch. Retain the vowel note and only refresh its anchor after the approved lamed sheva.

The complete sin lower body merges into a broad descending drop and terminal button. The same-font shin uses the same base letterform; its literal sheva in השבועה has two additional comparably rounded nodes clearly below an ordinary foot. The target lacks a separable ordinary-foot/upper-dot boundary: hiriq attached to a thickened foot, qamats-like shoulder/stem and coalesced sheva remain competitors. Retain; the upper sin point is an existing separate mark and stays unchanged.

The complete pe descends from its large joined foot into one lower button through a narrow waist. Literal same-page pe sheva in ומפני has two independent lower levels after its ordinary flatter foot. The local pe of לכפרה is itself heavily coalesced and is recorded only as a neutral morphology comparison, not as a new point proof. Hiriq below a thickened foot and a merged qamats/compound arrangement remain inseparable in the target. Retain without filling from expected spelling.
